title: Verifier Evaluation After Decoding
statement: Let $x$ and $r$ be bit strings, let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $C,C'$ be arithmetic circuits with $n$ input variables. Suppose the total first and second projections of $x$ decode to $C$ and $C'$, respectively. The verifier on $x$ and $r$ equals false exactly when both circuits are well formed and the zero test on the circuit representing their difference returns true; if either circuit is not well formed, the verifier returns true.
hypotheses_covered: the first projection of $x$ decodes to $C$
the second projection of $x$ decodes to $C'$
